title: Browser IDE
description: Edit this box's workspace from a browser. It has its own access: being signed in to the panel does not open it, and its token opens nothing else.

open.title: Open to its token
open.body: Anyone holding the token can edit the workspace.

expired.title: Token expired
expired.body: Nothing can get in until a new token is issued.

no_token.title: No token yet
no_token.body: The IDE is on, but nothing can get in until a token is issued.

off.title: Turned off
off.body: Nothing can reach this box's files through the IDE.

enableHint: Turning this off ends the current token.

token.title: Access token
token.description: A secret shown once. Rotating it ends the previous one at once.
token.lifetimeHint: It stops working by itself after this long.

issued.title: Copy this token
issued.warning: Keep it somewhere safe. Anyone holding it can edit this box's files until it expires.

revoke.title: Revoke this token?
revoke.description: Whoever holds it is locked out at once. The IDE stays on: issue a new token to get back in.

confinement: The IDE edits the files in this box's workspace and nothing else. It has no terminal, doesn't follow links out of the workspace, and can't reach the panel, another service or the server.

signIn.title: Open the IDE
signIn.body: Paste this box's IDE token. Signing in to the panel does not open it.
signIn.expired: This token has expired. Issue a new one on the box's IDE tab.
signIn.invalid: This token can't open this IDE.
signIn.tokenHint: Issued on this box's IDE tab.

tree.label: Files
tree.truncated: This folder holds more than can be shown.
tree.notEditable: Not an ordinary file, so it can't be opened here.

editor.emptyBody: Files in this box's workspace are listed on the left.
editor.binaryBody: The editor only opens text files.
editor.tooLargeBody: The editor opens files up to {{max}} KB.
editor.conflict: Something else changed this file since you opened it. Your edits are still here.

dialogs.name: Name
dialogs.deleteFileBody: This file is removed from the workspace.
dialogs.deleteFolderBody: This folder and everything in it are removed from the workspace.
dialogs.nameHint: Just the name: it is created in the current folder.
